# The Monsters I Feared Weren't Monsters at All

> Growing up gay, I wasn’t afraid of Frankenstein’s monster. I was afraid of becoming the man Hollywood coded as one. Ryan Murphy’s The Shards almost breaks that old trope. Almost.
